After the description, I will ask you to prepare the function call for execution, but don't execute it until I explicitly request it.

Of course. Here is the step-by-step implementation plan for your request using only function calls:

First, a 140x140x10mm block is created to serve as the initial plate. This block will be the foundation of the corner geometry and is therefore an additive operation.

Second, another 140x140x10mm block is created for the second plate. It is positioned at a 90-degree angle to the first plate, with one of its edges flush against an edge of the first plate to form the corner. This is also an additive operation.

Third, a 45x45x10mm block is defined. This block is positioned precisely in the center of the first plate. This block is then subtracted from the existing geometry, creating the square cutout.
